visual_goal: Show the engine consuming the same events as SFP but posting nothing: its would-be summaries go to a comparison desk, while SFP alone posts to the general ledger.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. At the far left, a group of three small generic boxes labeled once 'Product systems'. One thick arrow from them into a long horizontal pipe labeled 'Event backbone' with small lightning-bolt icons flowing inside it. From the pipe, two arrows: one up to an open book labeled 'SFP subledger' drawn in solid green, and one down to a machine with gears labeled 'Accounting engine' drawn faded with dashed outlines, like a ghost. From 'SFP subledger' one solid arrow right to a large open book labeled 'General ledger', and one arrow down to a desk with a magnifying glass labeled 'Shadow comparison'. From 'Accounting engine' one dashed arrow right into the same 'Shadow comparison' desk. From 'Shadow comparison' one arrow right to a checklist board labeled 'Variances'. From 'SFP subledger' one more arrow up-right to a small box with coins labeled 'Payouts'. Exactly seven arrows. The ghostly engine has no arrow to the general ledger.
alt: Product systems publish events onto a backbone; the SFP subledger posts to the general ledger and payouts while a ghostly accounting engine computes the same summaries that go only to a shadow comparison desk.

visual_goal: Show the cohort register as a railway switch that sends each entity to exactly one book of record, with SFP reverse-shadowing moved cohorts, a three-way tie-out, and partners and payouts reading through a layer that hides which book is authoritative.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration in three bands. At the far left a pipe labeled 'Event backbone' feeding a railway track switch labeled 'Cohort register' that splits into rails. Middle column, top to bottom: an open book labeled 'SFP subledger' at the end of the upper rail, a faded open book labeled 'Reverse shadow' at the end of a thin dashed orange rail, and a gear machine labeled 'Accounting engine' at the end of the lower rail. Right column, top to bottom: a large open book labeled 'General ledger'; a balance scale labeled 'Three-way tie-out' with a small bank building labeled 'PSP clearing' to its right; and a translucent frosted glass panel labeled 'Read model' with a small box labeled 'Payouts' to its right. Exactly eight arrows, all pointing rightwards: 'SFP subledger' to 'General ledger'; 'Accounting engine' to 'General ledger'; 'Reverse shadow' to 'Three-way tie-out' (dashed); 'Accounting engine' to 'Three-way tie-out'; 'PSP clearing' pointing left into 'Three-way tie-out'; 'SFP subledger' to 'Read model'; 'Accounting engine' to 'Read model'; 'Read model' to 'Payouts'.
alt: A railway switch, the cohort register, routes each entity to either the SFP subledger or the accounting engine; a reverse shadow feeds a three-way tie-out with PSP clearing, and partners and payouts read through a frosted read-model panel.

visual_goal: Show one cohort's lifecycle as stepping stones with gates, rollback paths back to shadow before the first close is signed, and a separate retirement gate.
prompt: A board-game path of six rounded stepping stones from left to right: 'SFP book', 'Shadow', 'Cut-over day', 'Dual run', 'Engine only', 'Retired'. Four small gate posts with flags stand on the path: 'G0' between 'SFP book' and 'Shadow', 'G1' between 'Shadow' and 'Cut-over day', 'G2' between 'Dual run' and 'Engine only', and 'G3' between 'Engine only' and 'Retired'. 'Cut-over day' and 'Dual run' touch directly. Exactly two curved orange arrows, both labeled 'rollback': a small one arcing above the path from 'Cut-over day' back to 'Shadow', and a larger one arcing below the path from 'Dual run' back to 'Shadow'. A vertical signed sheet of paper stands right after 'Dual run', just before the 'G2' flag, labeled 'first close signed'. The 'Engine only' stone has a small wrench icon, and the 'Retired' stone shows an archive box.
alt: Six stepping stones from SFP book through Shadow, Cut-over day, Dual run and Engine only to Retired, separated by gates G0 to G3, with rollback arrows back to Shadow that end at the first signed close.

visual_goal: Show the migration timeline: long proving bars before two short cut-over days, long dual running and decommissioning after, every bar ending at a gate.
prompt: A horizontal timeline chart with a bottom axis divided into three equal year segments labeled '2028', '2029', '2030', and four stacked swim lanes labeled at the left 'Stage 0', 'Stage 1', 'Stage 2', 'Stage 3'. Stage 0 lane: a long blue bar labeled 'Shadow run' starting in the middle of the 2028 segment and ending one third into the 2029 segment, ending at a small gate flag. Stage 1 lane: a small lightning-bolt diamond labeled 'UK and INTL cut-over' at one third into the 2029 segment, directly below the end of the Shadow run bar, followed by a short teal bar labeled 'Reverse shadow' ending at a gate flag at two thirds into 2029. Stage 2 lane: a small lightning-bolt diamond labeled 'EEA cut-over' near the end of the 2029 segment, followed by a short teal bar labeled 'Reverse shadow' ending at a gate flag at one sixth into 2030. Stage 3 lane: an orange bar labeled 'Archive drills' from one sixth to one half into the 2030 segment, then a thin dotted line to a diamond labeled 'SFP deleted' near the end of the 2030 segment.
alt: A four-lane timeline from 2028 to 2030: a long shadow run, two short cut-over days for UK and INTL and for EEA each followed by reverse shadow bars, and archive drills ending with SFP's deletion, every bar ending at a gate.
